correctness.rationale: For each source dual chain, order preservation gives a single target chain; exact p-morphism back equality forces a surjection onto a terminal segment, counted by binomial(n-1,k-1). Idempotence forces each active chain to collapse only its initial unselected prefix and fixes the final segment; each inactive chain independently chooses one of b_n(k_j) terminal subsegment surjections into an active component. Placements are weighted by (m)_r divided by repeated-length factorials; dual-image upset algebras have the claimed product-chain type. Boundary cases, repeated labels, and image-rank collisions are included. A separately implemented exhaustive brute enumeration for ten parameter pairs and algebraic implication checks through six dual vertices passed 19555 comparisons.

value.rationale: The idempotent elements govern retractions and direct summands, a structural invariant not recoverable from the total number of maps. This is a natural complete two-parameter classification of a standard finite Heyting family, with exact multiplicities of all image isomorphism types and a sharp rank-support theorem. The Boolean boundary recovers idempotent transformation counts; larger chains introduce genuinely different binomial-weighted fibers. The claim is wider than a small arbitrary computation or known-table recomputation.
